sourceNotes.text: This is a researcher-authored source-analysis and shared-link troubleshooting task, not a customer incident or live service run. Answer the complete original question for the supplied finite scenario and explain relevant alternate branches. In edit mode also deliver a reusable source program, repairing the supplied existing draft. In consume mode keep the supplied program unchanged. Facts are synthetic request, clock, database rows and operation error observations. Collections are complete finite populations; field names follow Go store structs, membership rows have SpaceID/UserID/Role. storeErrors null means the named storage operation returns normally, not an access grant; absent facts are unknown. No external allowed/access decision is supplied. Read source-visible helper logic or retain it as a named unresolved responsibility. Broader security-skill duties and unavailable deployment facts remain explicit. conversionUsers is the finite population returned by the later ListUsers call during conversion, separately from users used for access context; conversionCreator in storeErrors describes that operation's error. events.because: The response creator is independently resolved during conversion, not reused from access-context resolution.
A missing conversion creator returns errMemoCreatorNotFound, which GetSharedMemo normalizes to NOT_FOUND.
Placement is projected only for an assigned, valid Space when the viewer is the author, an active member, or an instance administrator; the share token itself is not one of those conditions.

The response creator comes from convertMemoFromStore's independent creator lookup; the response includes memo-scoped reactions and attachments, passes nil relations, clears Parent, and any Space projection derives from viewer relations rather than the token.

gaps: The finite workflow records response inclusion of memo-scoped reactions and attachments but does not materialize every converted collection row.
Full protobuf field conversion, snippet generation, placement projection, and Connect transport error mapping are outside the requested token-access relation model.
